scientific_decision.reason: Original V3 pilot failed its 2% continuation heuristic; atom_crps was 2.7043119888% worse than atom_mse_only. No positive current evidence authorizes expensive confirmation; no rule change or automatic lambda0 promotion.

estimand.task: one-step forecast of population sigma7 of a seven-return rolling window; ddof=0; same contemporaneously available OHLCV inputs
estimand.known_overlap: six returns known in input; Y^2 = A + (6/49)*U^2; A computed causally from inputs
estimand.primary: mean across fixed individual seed RMSEs on common target dates; not ensemble RMSE or square-root of pooled seed MSE
estimand.gain: Delta_j = E_seed[RMSE_j] - E_seed[RMSE_atom_crps]; positive favors candidate
secondary: CRPS_U for comparable full predictive distributions only
coverage and width from a separately fitted and frozen calibration split
latency and memory under common CPU batch1 conditions
estimand.margin_selection_policy: No margin from observed gain, favorable p-value or original 2% pilot threshold. Operational use/cost reasoning must predate final outcomes.

data.proposal: Prospectively acquired target endpoints after this decision and a complete seven-window boundary purge, or a genuinely never-opened externally locked holdout with access log. No such panel is certified here. End date and sample duration await power and maturity.
data.WIKI_AAPL_limit: The admitted D01 source ends in 2013. A future AAPL holdout needs a separately admitted current source; a new historical slice cannot silently become independent.

common_treatment.ratios_status: template only; absolute dates and resulting counts must be fixed before test outcomes
common_treatment.target_test_opening: once after all tuning/calibration and artifacts are hashed
common_treatment.budget_measure: both configurations and wall/active compute; counts alone do not equalize model cost
common_treatment.neural_optimizer_template: AdamW batch32 clip1 weight_decay0; confirm frozen E2 recipes and comparable relative grids before freeze
common_treatment.classic_recipes: Persistence and SeasonalNaive deterministic; ARIMA original frozen order/window. Do not create fake duplicate HPO or seeds; document any refit policy before lock.
common_treatment.capacity_audit: parameters and justified FLOPs method all neural systems; report candidate/benchmark difference and matched-capacity sensitivity if necessary

sampling.seed_id_policy: pair RNG coordinates across neural systems; no best-seed selection
sampling.deterministic_control_policy: one trajectory per deterministic recipe; broadcast only in paired estimators, never count as new fits or independent calendars
sampling.temporal_unit: ordered target endpoints with overlap/dependence, not seed x date independent rows
sampling.market_unit: dataset/origin; initialization seeds are not markets

stationary_bootstrap.scope: paired stationary bootstrap of the actual mean-individual-RMSE gain functional; resample same temporal blocks for every model and preserve complete paired seeds
assumptions: weak stationarity or justified locally stationary segment
no leaking future values into train or resampling

DM_HLN.scope: temporal influence-function delta-method adaptation for mean individual RMSE, not a canonical loss-difference DM falsely relabeled RMSE
DM_HLN.HLN_horizon_policy: use actual forecast horizon1, not rolling window7; sensitivity to HAC lags and any extra overlap must be justified
assumptions: valid first-order RMSE expansion and adequate calendar

GW_or_CW.choice: Giacomini-White-style conditional predictive-ability extension for nonnested predictors, conditional direction/margin tests using predeclared causal low/high-A instruments; Clark-West only if nesting and correction are formally established
GW_or_CW.scope: An omnibus conditional-difference rejection alone is not evidence candidate is better. Must establish one-sided favorable direction under prescribed margin and align with primary functional.
GW_or_CW.instrument_threshold: fit-only median A; freeze before test
assumptions: stationary moments and positive HAC covariance

proposed_F2_test_plan.canonical_MCS_auxiliary: May report 90% MCS with common squared-error loss; it does not establish RMSE margin or replace one of three required primary-aligned rejections merely by model survival.
proposed_F2_test_plan.why_not_claim_closed: A named list is not proof of a valid battery. Implementations, direction and shared estimand require review/tests before registration. Three t/Wilcoxon/sign tests on seeds do not automatically satisfy temporal F2.

error_control.Holm_scope: all19rivals x all3requiredprocedures; do not adjust each test separately to a smaller family
error_control.per_rival_rule: max of its three globally Holm-adjusted pvalues < .05 and all direction/margin checks pass
error_control.all_rivals_rule: all19 contrasts must pass; no best-rival or best-test selection
error_control.effects: Cliff absolute >=.147 or Cohen absolute >=.2 only when unit/assumptions justify; preserve paired calendar/seed scope
error_control.intervals: paired temporal95% intervals with clearly stated marginal/simultaneous status; lower gain bound>0, ideally>delta; report all rivals

adequacy_and_robustness.baseline: must beat Persistence and physical controls on prescribed primary dates
adequacy_and_robustness.generalization_gap: fit/selection/test under same data risks; margin for acceptable gap fixed before outcomes
distribution_diagnostics: PIT randomization appropriate to discrete mass atU0
coverage and width from frozen split calibration
CRPS_U proper scoring on comparable distributions
adequacy_and_robustness.calibration: Separate calibration data never tuning/test; fit on calibration only and bind calibrator to exact model/weights/version. Do not inherit additive calibrator for V3.
robustness: input missingness/noise perturbations fixed before test
hardware/cost/seed subsets prespecified without selecting favorable subset
adequacy_and_robustness.Nadeau_Bengio: Only if repeated overlapping training/test partitions actually exist and variance correction applies; not manufactured from days/seeds of one chronology.
adequacy_and_robustness.additional_rule: better primary mean in at least2/3 panels and no significant inferiority to any family rival in any panel; nonrejection is not demonstrated equivalence
adequacy_and_robustness.cross_dataset: Friedman+Iman-Davenport with paired Holm or declared Bayesian alternative, limited by three domains and dependence; report ranks/individual scales, no pooled raw RMSE

budget.checkpoint_policy: reuse existing source-hash/cohort/state protections; no change to either old master
budget.restart_policy: durable model/optimizer/RNG at epoch boundary; immutable original deadlines; no budget reset
budget.neural_fit_upper_formula: 4 datasets *15 neural systems *(3 HPO + R final) *120 seconds; R=10 illustrative 93600s=26h, not authorized budget or power justification
measured_cost_fields: inference CPU batch1 latency with warmup
peak processRSS versus incremental memory clearly labeled

adapter.reuse: immutable source hashes, admission, CPU preparation, continuation identity and durable checkpoint policy; never call old additive worker as V3

required_before_go: author scientific rationale accepting an explicitly new limited question despite failed heuristic
genuinely unexposed common data admission and endpoints
valid tested F2 three-procedure battery matching estimand
full-family prospective power with adequate pilot variances and >=10 planned seeds
approved comparable time/configuration budget and capacity audit
exact V3 runner/version integration and tests
final protocol annotated tag and timestamp before outcomes
